caseName: Stein v. Lewisville Independent School District
caseNameFull: Stein, Administratrix v. Lewisville Independent School District

opinions.text: Appeal from Ct. Civ. App. Tex., 2d Sup. Jud. Dist., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
